title: Load balancer, API gateway or CDN?

rows.label: Main job
values: Authenticate, throttle and route API calls

rows.label: Where it runs
values: In your region, before your servers
In your region, before your APIs

rows.label: Knows callers and API keys
values: Only simple rules at the edge

rows.label: Reach for it for
values: Any service with more than one instance

tip: A common production path uses all three in a row: the CDN at the edge, then an API gateway or layer-7 load balancer, then your services.
